results.scope: Configuration and read-only database evidence; no provider verification

gates.detail: Checked configuration has no leading or trailing whitespace.
Database URL is present; connectivity and migration state require --database.

Authentication secret passes format checks and contains whitespace. Preserve the key verbatim; coordinate any intentional rotation because trimming changes the signing key and invalidates sessions. Deployed sign-in still requires verification.
Application and authentication origins agree; deployed DNS and callback behavior are unverified.
Live-format credentials and a distinct Connect signing secret exist; provider account, endpoint scope, and live settlement are unverified.
Billing fields are present; verify live price amounts, currency, interval, endpoint scope, and portal configuration with the provider audit.
Email configuration is present; sender verification, authorized receipt, bounce handling and delivery alerts are unverified.
All four private R2 storage settings are required.
Vercel scheduler token is configured; this report does not invoke authenticated task routes.
Scheduled work is paused. Set exactly true only in a new deployment after release and delivery verification.
Error monitoring has a destination; event ingestion, alert routing and an operational responder are unverified.
SMS is optional. Configuration alone does not verify sender permissions, opt-out behavior, recipient authorization or delivery.

Stripe retries failed signed deliveries; no application replay worker is wired. Review both provider endpoint failure queues and assign recovery ownership. An empty local webhook table is not proof of successful delivery.
The database accepted a read-only inspection transaction.
All columns required by the generated client exist. This is a column-presence check, not a complete backup or restore test.
Required unique keys exist, including document and payment identities.
Completed database migration names and checksums match this checkout.
Stored webhook rows: 0 failed, 0 dead-lettered, 0 unprocessed for over 15 minutes. Provider queues must also be checked.
Open invoice delivery stages: 0 need outcome review, 0 have stale in-flight claims, 0 await retry or configuration. This report never retries them.
A recoverable production backup and tested restore procedure require separate evidence; this script cannot verify them.
